caption:
A lead goes quiet for three days. Nobody notices until they call your competitor instead.

Black Arrow OS fixes that with one screen. Drag every lead into a stage: New, Quoted, Follow Up, Won. Watch your pipeline value and win rate update as you move them.

Set a follow-up date the moment you talk to someone. The tool flags it automatically, while there's still time to save the job.

Track cost per lead and return on ad spend in the same dashboard. Export everything to CSV whenever you want it.

$0 forever. No signup. Free for your first 25 contacts.

DM TOOLS

#LeadFollowUp #ServiceBusiness #CRM #SmallBusinessGrowth #HomeServices
rationale: Offers/Lead Magnets is under-served this cycle, and this rotates to Black Arrow OS with only its verified on-site specs, framed around the dropped-lead pain that's already resonating in this account's best-performing recent videos.
